new_roles.description:
**Director of Quality & Compliance**
====================================

**Southern Peaks, Canon City CO**

[Full-Time)

$95,000 To $120,000 Annually

DailyPay Available

**Looking for More Than Just a Job?**
-------------------------------------

At Abraxaswe believe every person deserves the opportunity to live a meaningful, fulfilling, and independent life.

We’re seeking compassionate, dedicated professionals who are looking for more than a paycheck. We’re looking for individuals who want to make a difference, build rewarding careers, and become part of a team committed to helping others succeed.

Whether you’re beginning your career, changing professions, or bringing years of experience, we provide the training, support, and opportunities needed to help you thrive.

**About Abraxas**
-----------------

For more than 50 years, Abraxas has been dedicated to improving lives through high-quality services and support.

Our employees play a vital role in helping individuals achieve greater independence, confidence, and success while promoting dignity, respect, inclusion, and personal choice.

Every day, our team members make a meaningful impact by supporting people in reaching their goals and living their best lives.

**Why Join Our Team?**
======================

**Competitive Pay & Benefits**
------------------------------

* Competitive Compensation
* DailyPay – Access Your Earned Wages Before Payday
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance- AFTER 30 DAYS
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Programs
* Employee Referral Bonuses
* Company-Paid Training

**Career Growth & Development**
-------------------------------

* Paid Training Programs
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Certification Opportunities
* Leadership Development Programs
* Career Advancement Opportunities
* Opportunities Across Multiple Service Lines

**Meaningful Work That Matters**
--------------------------------

* Make a Difference Every Day
* Support Individuals and Families
* Build Meaningful Relationships
* Strengthen Communities
* Join a Mission-Driven Organization

**What You’ll Do**
==================

As the Director of Quality & Compliance, you will:

Oversees compliance with applicable Colorado Department of Human Services (CDHS) Volume 7 residential licensing rules, including 12 CCR 2509-8, Section 7.714, as well as payer contracts and Joint Commission standards.

* Reviews and approves corrective action plans for regulatory, payer, and accreditation findings before routing them for final approval. Verifies implementation and sustained compliance.
* Works with Quality and Compliance Specialist and Program Directors to prepare for licensing inspections, Medicaid and managed care reviews, and accreditation surveys.
* Serves as a compliance liaison with CDHS and applicable Regional Accountable Entities (RAEs) and other payers. Reviews provider manuals and contract changes and translates requirements into program procedures.
* Conducts program and follow-up audits, including reviews of admissions, assessments, treatment plans, service documentation, discharge planning, and continuity of care.
* Provides technical assistance to Quality and Compliance Specialists and trains program staff on licensing, payer, and accreditation requirements.
* Develops monitoring tools with Quality and Compliance Specialists to verify compliance and consistent implementation of program policies.
* Analyzes audit findings, incidents, grievances, clinical outcomes, and authorization or denial trends. Reports findings and tracks improvement actions with program leaders.
* Partners with Clinical, Admissions, and Billing to oversee utilization management, including prior authorization, concurrent and continued-stay review, medical necessity and level-of-care documentation, and responses to denials and appeals.
* Develops and reviews policies and procedures, supports the annual review process, and verifies that programs maintain current policy and procedure manuals.
* Participates on various internal and external committees as needed.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Who We’re Looking For**
=========================

You may be a great fit if you are:

✔ Compassionate

✔ Dependable

✔ Patient

✔ Team-Oriented

✔ Service-Focused

✔ Professional

✔ Positive

✔ Committed to Helping Others

**Qualifications**
==================

Master's degree in social sciences, healthcare or related field and five years of quality and compliance experience or bachelor’s degree in social sciences, healthcare or related field and seven years quality and compliance experience

* Ability to effectively supervise employees.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Colorado Volume 7 residential licensing requirements, Health First Colorado behavioral health managed care, and applicable accreditation standards is critical.
* Ability to interpret and teach the application of regulations, payer requirements, accreditation standards, and contractual language.
* Experience with behavioral health utilization management, including authorization, medical necessity and continued-stay documentation, and payer audits. Experience in youth residential mental health or psychiatric residential treatment facilities (PRTFs) is preferred.
* Experience with Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA) compliance, including staff training, audit preparation, and corrective action follow-up, is preferred.
* Knowledge of adolescent residential mental health treatment, including trauma-informed care, co-occurring conditions, and the needs of youth involved in child welfare or juvenile justice.
* Proven ability to develop and revise policies that meet licensing, payer, contractual, and accreditation requirements.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in written form, with a diverse group of people including regulatory agency representatives, employees, clients, governing body members, and the general public.
* Must be available for travel, to include overnight stays.
* Must have a valid driver’s license.
* Ability to work with computers and the necessary software typically used by the department.

**Physical Requirements (If Applicable)**
=========================================

* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and assist individuals as needed
* Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation

**Apply Today**
===============

Some jobs pay the bills. Some jobs build careers. This job changes lives.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your compassion, dedication, and hard work make a real difference every day, we encourage you to apply today.

**Join our team and become the reason someone has a better day.**

### **About Our Organization**

**Abraxas** is part of the Inperium family of companies.

Employment for this position is administered through Apis Services, Inc.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Apis Services, Inc., Inperium Inc., and affiliates provide equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment in compliance with all federal and applicable state and local laws and regulations, including nondiscrimination in hiring and employment.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

This policy of nondiscrimination and equal employment opportunity extends to every phase and aspect of hiring and employment

new_roles.title: Director - Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
**Overview**

Westchester Jewish Community Services (WJCS) is an award-winning nonprofit human services organization founded in 1943. Today, it has grown to be the largest provider of licensed outpatient community behavioral health services and one of the largest human service agencies in Westchester County. WJCS delivers innovative programs and services and compassionate care to more than 20,000 people of all ages and backgrounds throughout the county.

We are currently seeking a full-time Director of Quality Assurance to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for investigations, clinical compliance, implementation of quality initiatives, incident information collection and monitoring, and other duties as assigned.

The salary range for this full-time position is $110,000.

**Responsibilities**

As a valued member of our team, your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

* Investigates reportable incidents and notable occurrences within clinics, satellite programs and trauma division.
* Maintains records related to incidents; chairs required meetings as needed.
* Provides required incident information to be entered into NIMRS (OMH Incident Reporting and Management Application).
* Monitors required data metrics that are reported to regulatory bodies (i.e. OMH/OASAS/SAMHSA)
* Implements and tracks annual quality improvement initiatives.
* Identifies, implements and monitors staff trainings necessary for CCBHC licensure.
* Reviews and makes necessary changes to clinic policies and procedures.
* Investigates clinic compliance issues as assigned.
* Develops, distributes, and tabulates responses for the annual Consumer Satisfaction Surveys
* Conduct annual audit as requested.
* Completes necessary documents related to CBCHC and OMH/OASAS recertification and audit requests as needed.
* Acts as liaison with Utilization Review process.
* Attends Clinic Leadership, Clinic Transformation, compliance and other required meetings.

**Requirements**

We are seeking candidates who possess the following qualifications:

* Master’s Degree in Social Work or PhD in Psychology preferred
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience working in community behavioral health settings, with leadership skills preferred
* Knowledge of OMH, OASAS and SAMHSA regulations
* Ability to investigate incidents, including allegations of abuse
* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing.
* Ability to work closely with members of the executive staff ( i.e. CMO, CCO) and direct service staff
* Strong leadership skills
* Excellent critical thinking & writing skills
* Excellent computer skills
* Excellent knowledge of OMH, OASAS, OPWDD, SAMHSA & CCBHC regulations
* Excellent clinical and diagnostic skills

**What WJCS has to offer you**

In addition to meaningful work and a supportive team environment, we offer a competitive benefits package, including:

* Generous paid time off
* Comprehensive Health Benefits, Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and a Healthcare Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA)
* 403(b) Plan and an Agency-Paid Pension Plan
* Ongoing Professional Development and Training
* Employee Assistance Program
* Tuition, day-care, and personal emergency reimbursements
* Disability and life insurance
* Staff appreciation events and employee mental health and wellness initiatives

new_roles.title: Director of Quality, Regulatory & Improvement
new_roles.description:
***Title:*** ***Director of Quality, Regulatory and Improvement***

**Job Summary:**
----------------

This senior leadership role leads the quality departments for all Deringer-Ney locations globally. The Director implements best practices and metrics to coordinate all teams under a unified Quality Management System and is responsible for ensuring that the company's products, services, and manufacturing processes comply with strict government laws, industry standards, and internal quality systems. The role plans, coordinates, and directs the activities of the quality assurance and compliance programs to ensure the production of consistent, reliable products that meet or exceed established standards, and leads the continuous improvement team to support, train, and execute the DNIOS system.

***Supervisory Responsibilities:****Yes*

**Duties/Responsibilities:**
----------------------------

* Manage all quality departments by formulating, developing, and overseeing global goals, objectives, policies, procedures, systems, and outcomes pertaining to quality controls, assessments, and audits.
* Quality Management Systems (QMS): Build, maintain, and continuously improve QMS frameworks (such as ISO 13485 and ISO 9001).
* Develop a high-performance team by acquiring, developing, training, coaching, cultivating, and managing talented Quality Control personnel.
* Maintain and improve the quality system through routine system audits and corrective actions, and ensure that corrective actions, whether internal or external, are handled in a timely manner.
* Risk & Lifecycle Management: Oversee design controls, validation packages, complaint handling, and post-market surveillance (such as Automotive Reporting).
* Manage and maintain quality inspection and product release programs for raw materials, work in process (WIP), and finished goods.
* Regulatory Compliance & Filings: Lead product submissions and act as the primary liaison during agency audits.
* Disseminate quality awareness, adherence, and developments to global stakeholders by scheduling and performing regional quality audits and by ensuring that ISO systems are managed and maintained.
* Serve as an active member of the DNI Leadership Team, sharing the function's progress toward its goals while setting, and driving toward, an aspirational vision for a best-in-class quality department.
* Create a Cost of Poor Quality metric for the organization and set specific goals to improve quality performance across the company.
* Lead the development of the Annual Strategic Planning (P.D.C.A.) Cycle to include the Improvement Process.
* Lead the organization in attaining key metrics based on Balanced Scorecard (BSC) Objectives. Understand the department's key performance indicators and leading and lagging indicators, and contribute to achieving these goals, both individually and as a team.
* With the CIP Team, perform systematic audits designed to confirm that process standards are being utilized and met (BSC One-Page Reports).
* Interact with and make recommendations and presentations to the Executive Leadership Group via standardized checks: weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end. Maintain the PDCA Cycle while focusing on BSC Objectives.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**
------------------------------

* Strong background in ISO 9000 system management, including training and auditing.
* Strong background in ISO 13485 system management and thorough knowledge of FDA requirements and other international standards that regulate the medical device industry.
* Knowledge of automated inspection equipment, including vision systems and coordinate measuring devices.
* Adept at delegating and managing multiple tasks with various levels of priority.
* Excellent communication skills; must be able to present ideas, results, and requirements effectively throughout the organization and to the customer on a timely basis.
* Expert skill set in applied statistics, reliability, design of experiments, MSA, GR&R, and project management.
* Fluency with various software packages commonly used in project management, database, SPC, word processing, and data acquisition.
* Analytical, problem-solving, project management, facilitation, and decision-making skills are essential.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, resolve conflict, and promote teamwork.
* Ability to see and hear the facts from several viewpoints while promoting success through interactive problem solving and teamwork.

**Experience & Education Requirements:**
----------------------------------------

* Technical degree (BS, BSE, or BSME) with a minimum of 10 years' experience in quality engineering or quality management.
* Strong preference for relevant industry experience in a metals or electrical connectors company or similar.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, or Regulatory Affairs within a regulated field such as medical devices, automotive, or defense.
* Preferred certifications: Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE).
* Demonstrated project management skills in the areas of process control, SPC, automotive PPAP submission, and statistical analysis.
* Lean Green Belt or Black Belt certification, Six Sigma, and DMAIC process experience.
* Actively continuing training through courses and seminars.

***Physical Requirements:***

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times.
* Must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization’s facilities.
* Travel to other locations as required.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
Job Summary:

### **Position Summary**

The Director of Quality is an execution-focused leader responsible for translating WellBe’s enterprise quality strategy into disciplined, measurable operations across markets and health plan contracts.

This role leads the day-to-day Quality function, manages and develops team members, and redesigns care-gap closure workflows to be simpler, standardized, scalable, and integrated into clinical practice.

The Director partners closely with market, clinical, pharmacy, analytics, technology, coding, and health plan stakeholders to improve HEDIS and Medicare Advantage Stars performance, strengthen data reliability, increase frontline accountability, and ensure the organization consistently converts quality insights into action.

Job Description:

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** 
Lead day-to-day execution of the Quality program across Part C and Part D, converting enterprise goals into clear workplans, owners, timelines, operating rhythms, and measurable results. 
Directly manage, coach, and performance-manage Quality team members; establish clear productivity, quality, service, and accountability standards. 
Map end-to-end care-gap closure workflows across measures, markets, and health plan contracts; identify handoffs, rework, manual steps, failure points, and unnecessary variation. 
Redesign and standardize workflows so care-gap identification, outreach, documentation, closure, submission, and reconciliation are consistently executed and sustainable at scale. 
Engage Markets using structured working sessions that diagnose barriers, assign actions, monitor commitments, and drive closure at the patient, provider, measure, and market levels. 
Partner with clinical operations and technology teams to surface prioritized care gaps at the point of care and embed closure activities into APP workflows. 
Lead implementation and adoption of Quality workflow tools, including in-house technologies, point-of-care solutions, telephony or workforce-management tools, and future AI-enabled capabilities. 
Oversee HEDIS chart abstraction, primary source validation, medical record retrieval, supplemental data submissions, and health plan audit support, with an emphasis on accuracy, timeliness, and reduced manual effort. 
Manage medication adherence and other Part D outreach operations; use performance and workflow data to improve productivity, assess capacity, and inform staffing decisions. 
Partner with analytics, IT, and health plan teams to strengthen WellBe-owned quality reporting using claims, EMR, pharmacy, and supplemental data; reconcile numerator, denominator, timing, and data-integrity differences. 
Use market-, provider-, measure-, and patient-level data to prioritize interventions, forecast performance, monitor outcomes, and adjust tactics quickly when results are off track. 
Evaluate and implement practical automation and AI-assisted solutions that reduce repetitive work, improve chart-review efficiency, and allow the team to focus on higher-value intervention and market partnership. 
Own point-of-care solution assessment and implementation, including identification of operational pain points, vendor coordination, rollout planning, training, adoption, and performance monitoring. 
Maintain current knowledge of NCQA, HEDIS, CMS, Stars, and applicable health plan requirements; ensure workflows, documentation, submissions, and controls remain compliant. 
Build effective cross-functional relationships and drive decisions with stakeholders across clinical operations, pharmacy, coding, analytics, technology, finance, compliance, markets, and external vendors.

Job Requirements:

### **Required Qualifications**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in nursing, healthcare administration, public health, health sciences, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

**Experience:** Seven or more years of progressive experience in healthcare quality, managed care, provider operations, population health, HEDIS, or Medicare Advantage Stars, including 3–5 years of people-management experience. Demonstrated experience setting expectations, coaching team members, managing performance, delivering measurable operational results, and mapping, redesigning, implementing, and sustaining complex workflows across multiple teams, markets, or contracts.

**Skills:** Strong working knowledge of NCQA HEDIS specifications, Medicare Advantage Stars, care-gap closure, medical record review, supplemental data, and quality operations. Proven ability to move between strategy and execution, manage multiple priorities, remove barriers, and deliver results in a fast-paced, matrixed organization. Strong people leadership, change-management, project-management, process-improvement, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and presentation tools; experience with workflow platforms, reporting tools, automation, or AI-enabled healthcare solutions preferred. High attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to maintain confidentiality.

### **Physical and Mental Requirements**

* Ability to stand or sit for extended periods.
* Visual acuity and fine motor.
* Ability to travel locally or nationally as needed.

### **Work Environment**

This role operates in a corporate, primarily remote environment and requires frequent collaboration across functions, markets, and external partners. Occasional travel and schedule flexibility may be required to support market operations, implementations, audits, and business priorities. No routine on-call responsibilities are expected.

### **Sponsorship Statement**

WellBe does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

### **Pay Transparency Statement**

Compensation for this position will be disclosed in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

### **Safety-Sensitive Statement**

This position has been designated as safety-sensitive. As such, the employee must be able to perform job duties in a manner that ensures the safety of themselves, coworkers, patients, and the public. The role requires full cognitive and physical functioning at all times.

Employees in safety-sensitive positions are subject to drug and alcohol testing, including for substances that may impair judgment or motor function, in accordance with applicable federal and state laws and company policy. Due to the safety-sensitive nature of this role and in alignment with federal law and workplace safety standards, the use of marijuana—including medical or recreational use—is prohibited. WellBe Senior Medical will comply with applicable state laws regarding medical marijuana and reasonable accommodations, where such laws do not conflict with safety requirements or federal regulations.

### **Drug Screening Requirement**

As a condition of employment, WellBe Senior Medical requires all candidates to successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening. Ongoing employment may also be contingent upon compliance with the company’s Drug-Free Workplace Policy, which includes random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion drug testing. The company reserves the right to test for substances that may impair an employee’s ability to safely and effectively perform their job duties.

### **Background Check Statement**

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, as permitted by law. As a healthcare organization, WellBe conducts monthly FACIS (Fraud and Abuse Control Information System) checks on all employees. Continued employment is contingent upon satisfactory results of these checks, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

### **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement**

WellBe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

### **Americans with Disabilities Act**

WellBe Senior Medical is committed to complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. If you require an accommodation during the application, interview or employment process, please contact Human Resources at HRPeopleLine@wellbe.com

### **At-Will Employment Statement**

Employment with WellBe is at-will unless otherwise specified by contract. This job description does not constitute an employment contract.

### **Disclaimer**

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary.

new_roles.title: Quality Director
new_roles.description:
**Build Your Career. Lead With Precision.**

Nammo Perry is a center of excellence for the design, development and production of munitions and pyrotechnic products for the U.S. Department of Defense. Nammo employees working at the Florida site manufacture all types of 40mm low and high velocity ammunition; pyrotechnic marking; signaling and tactical illumination devices; battlefield effects training simulators; demolition charges; hand grenade fuzes; and other ammunition components. Additionally, they provide load, assemble, and pack (LAP) services for large caliber direct-fire ammunition.

The **Director of Quality** provides strategic leadership and oversight of quality assurance, quality systems, supplier quality, and configuration management across Nammo Perry supporting the Large Caliber Systems and Aerospace Propulsion business units. Reporting to the President/General Manager, this position leads a multidisciplinary quality organization through four direct-report management functions: Configuration Management, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality Systems, and Quality Assurance. These functions collectively support supplier compliance, product conformity, manufacturing qualities, inspection and testing, calibration, customer quality, and configuration controls.

The Director is accountable for establishing and maintaining a robust quality management system (QMS), ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry requirements, and driving continuous improvement throughout the organization. A key strategic priority is leading the site's transformation from ISO9001 certification to AS9100 certification encompassing both business units under one unified quality management system, as well as a robust supplier quality program.

**Unique Benefits Designed with Care**

* Monday - Thursday work week working 10-hour days
* Relocation assistance provided
* 401(K) with a 6% company match
* 100% Employer-Paid Employee Only Medical Plan Option
* Employer Health Saving Account Contributions
* Two week’s vacation, one-week sick pay, and nine paid holidays

**What You’ll Do: Precision in Action**

**Strategic Quality Leadership**

* Develop and execute quality strategies aligned with organizational objectives, customer requirements, regulatory expectations, and long-term business growth.
* Provide leadership and accountability across configuration management, supplier quality systems, and quality assurance ensuring consistent quality standards across both business units.
* Monitor key performance indicators related to product conformity, supplier performance, customer satisfaction, cost of poor quality, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with site leadership to evaluate quality risks, organizational capabilities, resource allocation, and strategic improvement opportunities.

**Quality Management Systems**

* Maintain compliance with existing ISO9001 and AS9100requirements while continuing to foster an environment of continuous improvement.
* Provides strategic oversight of the Quality Systems Organization including internal audits, corrective and preventative actions, document control, calibration, and customer quality activities.
* Ensure effective management review processes, regulatory and customer audit readiness, and continuous improvement of quality systems and organizational performance.

**Supplier Quality and Configuration Management**

* Provide strategic oversight of Supplier Quality including supplier qualification, performance monitoring and auditing, incoming inspection, and supplier corrective action processes.
* Ensure supplier quality engineering and receiving inspection activities support material conformity traceability and manufacturing readiness
* Lead Configuration Management functions to ensure appropriate control of product configuration, engineering changes, technical documentation, and applicable customer requirements through the established configuration management and business systems.
* Partner with supply chain engineering and operations to manage supplier risk, resolve quality concerns, and maintain effective configuration and product controls.

**Manufacturing Quality Assurance and Testing**

* Provide leadership and oversight of the Quality Assurance organization supporting manufacturing quality, engineering inspection, and testing activities across both business units.
* Support integrated product teams by offer subject expertise, ensuring programmatic needs are met
* Ensure effective execution of product inspection verification testing and acceptance processes in accordance with applicable specifications and customer requirements.
* Oversee quality assurance capabilities including quality technicians, testing personnel, and specialized inspection activities.
* Drive continuous improvement throughout the organization using established lean six sigma tools.
* Partner with operations and engineering to address manufacturing nonconformances, implement corrective action, and improve process capability and product reliability.

**Compliance, Financial Performance, and People Leadership**

* Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace and defense quality standards, contractual requirements, customer specifications, and regulatory obligations.
* Develop and maintain quality budgets, departmental resources, and improvement initiatives while promoting cost effectiveness and operational efficiency.
* Lead, coach, and develop direct-report managers while establishing clear expectations for performance accountability and organizational effectiveness
* Partner with people and culture on workforce planning succession planning leadership development and employee engagement.

**What Dedicated Teammates Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or related technical field. Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, quality systems, or quality leadership within a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum of 5 years of management experience including demonstrated success leading managers or multidisciplinary quality teams.
* Experience in aerospace defense, energetic materials, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience implementing, maintaining, or leading quality management systems aligned with ISO9001 and AS9100 requirements.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing, quality supplier, quality configuration management, inspection, testing, and regulatory compliance.
* Proven ability to develop quality strategies, manage budgets, lead organizational change, and drive measurable performance improvements.
* Strong leadership communication, analytical, problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Direct experience in defense manufacturing, energetic material processing, ammunition production, or aerospace propulsion.
* Demonstrated experience leading an organization through initial AS9100 certification or significant QMS expansion.
* Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA).
* Experience with specialized inspection and testing methods, non-destructive testing, and manufacturing process qualifications.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and structured continuous improvement methodologies.

*Leadership Competencies:*

* Aligns operational capabilities and resources with business objectives and long-term growth.
* Drives performance improvements in safety, quality, delivery cost, and reliability.
* Build strong management teams and promotes accountability, engagement, and succession readiness.
* Demonstrate sound judgment, hazard awareness, and commitment to disciplined operations,
* Build effective partnerships across departments and business units
* Leads teams through expansion, organizational growth, and evolving operational requirements.

**Our Woking Conditions and Requirements**

* This position operates in both office and industrial manufacturing environments and requires regular interaction with production areas, maintenance, operations, and facility infrastructure.
* The role may involve prolonged periods of sitting, standing, and walking, including navigating manufacturing facilities and operational work areas.
* Employees must comply with applicable safety, security, and environmental requirements including the use of required personal protective equipment (PPE) when entering designated areas.
* The position may require occasional domestic or international travel and flexibility to support operational needs outside standard business hours.
* Must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

*Our values are the fundamental principles guiding the way we do business and interact with stakeholders.*

***DEDICATION:*** *We are enthusiastic and creative, always searching for the best solutions.* 
***PRECISION:*** *We are reliable and accurate in our technology, processes and business.* 
***CARE:*** *We are inclusive and open-minded, always encouraging team spirit and cooperation.*

*Nammo and its subsidiaries provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

**\*\*Note\*\*: Due to US Export Control laws and regulations; applicants selected for employment must show proof of a U.S. Person status before employment may begin.**

new_roles.title: Quality/Risk Director
new_roles.description:
**Quality/Risk Director Career Opportunity**

**Highly regarded and valued for your Quality/Risk Director expertise** 
Are you seeking a career that not only utilizes your skills but also aligns with your personal values, providing a profound sense of belonging and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference in patients' lives? Look no further than Encompass Health, the nation's leader in in-patient rehabilitation care. As a Quality/Risk Director, you will oversee a hospital-wide quality management program, collaborating with various stakeholders to monitor and enhance the quality of patient care services. Join a team that values collaboration, support, and inclusivity, and embark on a rewarding career close to home and close to your heart, complete with access to cutting-edge equipment and technology and a comprehensive benefits package from day one.

**A Glimpse into Our World** 
At Encompass Health, you'll experience the difference the moment you become a part of our team. Being at Encompass Health means aligning with a rapidly growing national inpatient rehabilitation leader. We take pride in the growth opportunities we offer and how our team unites for the greater good of our patients. Our achievements include being named one of the "World's Most Admired Companies" and receiving the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® Award, among other accolades, which is nothing short of amazing.

**Starting Perks and Benefits** 
At Encompass Health, we are committed to creating a supportive, inclusive, and caring environment where you can thrive. From **day one,** you will have access to:

* Affordable medical, dental, and vision plans for both full-time and part-time employees and their families.
* Generous paid time off that accrues over time.
* Opportunities for tuition reimbursement and continuing education.
* Company-matching 401(k) and employee stock purchase plans.
* Flexible spending and health savings accounts.
* A vibrant community of individuals passionate about the work they do!

**Become the Quality/Risk Director you've always aspired to be**

* Ensure compliance with regulatory agencies, accrediting bodies, corporate and hospital policies, and procedures. Develop, implement, and maintain quality assessment and improvement programs.
* Assess compliance with federal, state, and industry regulatory and accreditation standards, facilitating processes to remediate and/or maintain compliance. Provide organizational education related to regulations and standards and coordinate local, state, federal, and accreditation surveys.
* Use a variety of applications (including, but not limited to, PatCom, UDS, ORYX, and Press Ganey) to identify improvement opportunities, generate reports, research issues, identify resources, and access external databases.
* Ensure the update and maintenance of hospital plans, including the Provision of Care/Scope of Services, Leadership, Information Management, Utilization Review, Infection Control, and Patient Safety plans. Oversee risk management activities, including completion of incident reports, notice of potential claims, corrective action planning, and incident reporting to the Corporate Risk Manager.
* Coordinate the review, development, and implementation of hospital policies.
* .Communicate and collaborate with other departments to coordinate care and promptly resolve patient concerns or complaints.
* Celebrate the accomplishments and successes of our dedicated employees along the way.

**Qualifications**

* A bachelor's degree in healthcare or a related field is preferred.
* License or Certification as required by state regulations.
* Experience in Quality and/or Risk Management, including primary responsibility for performance improvement activities, regulatory compliance, conflict resolution, leadership, and risk management activities.

#LI-BG1

**The Encompass Health Way**

We proudly set the standard in care by leading with empathy, doing what's right, focusing on the positive, and standing stronger together. Encompass Health is a trusted leader in post-acute care with over 150 nationwide locations and a team of 36,000 exceptional individuals and growing!

At Encompass Health, we celebrate and welcome diversity in our inclusive culture. We provide equal employment opportunities regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, color, creed, age, mental or physical disability, or any other protected classification.

new_roles.title: Food Safety & Quality Director
new_roles.description:
**Universal Ingredients**

*Innovative Plant-Based Solutions for Global Industries*

Universal Ingredients is a global supplier of high-quality, plant-based specialty ingredients for human and pet consumption. With thousands of products and global sourcing capabilities, we provide customized, value-added solutions – including fruit and vegetable juices and concentrates, dehydrated ingredients, botanical extracts, flavors, and beverage systems – for food and beverage manufacturers worldwide.

Our advanced production capabilities, including aseptic beverage processing and flexible packaging solutions, enable safe, shelf-stable products with no preservatives. At the heart of our innovation is our Application Capabilities Lab, where food science experts collaborate with customers to develop market-ready solutions through product development, flavor analysis, sensory testing, and commercialization support.

Driven by innovation, sustainability, and partnership, Universal Ingredients helps customers stay ahead of evolving consumer preferences while delivering consistent quality, functionality, and performance across global markets.

Disclaimer: Shank’s Extracts manufactures various products that identify as major food allergens (milk, eggs, tree nuts, wheat, and soybeans) as well as several other food ingredients. We cannot guarantee you will not be exposed to skin and/or odor contact with these various ingredients. Your health and safety are our number one priority, and we will do our best to accommodate within reason.

**Summary**

Universal Ingredients is seeking a **Food Safety & Quality Director** to lead our Quality, Food Safety, and Regulatory functions. This leader will establish and strengthen quality systems across the organization, ensure regulatory and food safety compliance, and partner closely with Operations, Commercialization, R&D, Procurement, and Commercial teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with practical manufacturing leadership and has a track record of building a **preventive, accountable quality culture** focused on getting things right the first time.

**What You'll Be Doing (Essential Duties)**

* Lead the overall **Quality, Food Safety, and Regulatory strategy** for Universal Ingredients.
* Establish consistent quality standards, systems, policies, and performance expectations across the organization.
* Ensure compliance with applicable **FDA, FSMA, GMP, HACCP, SQF/GFSI, labeling, and customer requirements**.
* Strengthen **root-cause analysis, CAPA, change control, SOP/SSOP, and audit processes**.
* Partner with Operations to improve **first-pass quality** and reduce complaints, deviations, holds, rework, and recurring quality issues.
* Lead customer complaint management, regulatory inspections, certification audits, and customer audits.
* Oversee **supplier quality, regulatory documentation, specifications, labeling, and product compliance**.
* Support new product commercialization by embedding Quality and Regulatory requirements early in the process.
* Maintain strong **traceability, recall preparedness, and crisis-management** processes.
* Develop and lead a high-performing Quality and Regulatory organization while fostering shared accountability for quality and food safety across the business.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Engineering, or related field.
* Progressive Quality, Food Safety, and/or Regulatory leadership experience in **food, beverage, flavors, ingredients, or related manufacturing**.
* Experience in Aseptic process manufacturing
* Strong knowledge of FDA food regulations, FSMA, GMPs, HACCP, supplier quality, sanitation, traceability, and recall management.
* Experience leading audits, inspections, investigations, root-cause analysis, and CAPA.
* Strong manufacturing orientation with demonstrated ability to partner effectively with plant operations.
* Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Requirements**

* PCQI/HACCP certification, GFSI lead auditor certification, and experience in flavors, extracts, food ingredients, or complex food manufacturing

**Available Immediately Upon Hire: Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA, EAP, ID Theft, 401K, and PTO**

***EOE M/F/Disabled/Vet Employer*** 
**All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.**

new_roles.title: Director, Quality Assurance, Burger King, US&C
new_roles.description:
**Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.**

 

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $49 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 33,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.

RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

**Director, Quality Assurance**

*BURGER KING | UNITED STATES & CANADA | MIAMI, FLORIDA*

**Position Overview**

Burger King is seeking an experienced, collaborative and results-oriented Director of Quality Assurance to lead product quality and supplier quality performance across the U.S. and Canadian restaurant system. This leader ensures that products consistently meet approved specifications and guest expectations, while driving measurable improvements in product quality, consistency and supplier performance.

The Director serves as the primary product quality assurance leader and communication point of contact for the Burger King system, including franchisees, and works closely with suppliers and cross-functional partners. This position is not responsible for ownership or management of the Food Safety function. Burger King has a dedicated Food Safety department, with which this role partners closely on matters involving both product quality and food safety. The role has three primary areas of accountability.

RBI follows a 5 day, in-office work schedule to support collaboration. Successful candidates will be expected to work onsite 5 days per week.

**1. Improve Product Quality and Supplier Performance**

**Ensure suppliers meet current specifications and continuously improve the quality and consistency of products served to guests.**

* Own product quality standards and maintain clear, actionable specifications across the Burger King food and beverage portfolio.
* Work directly with suppliers to ensure adherence to approved product specifications and drive continuous improvement in product quality, consistency and sensory performance.
* Establish supplier quality performance expectations, scorecards and regular reviews; use data to identify trends, prioritize improvements and hold suppliers accountable.
* Analyze product testing, sensory evaluations, laboratory data, restaurant feedback and guest complaints to identify quality gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Lead product quality investigations and supplier corrective and preventive actions, validating sustained resolution and communicating results.
* Partner on supplier qualification, product validation and manufacturing process changes from a product quality perspective.
* Maintain and improve product quality systems, documentation, reporting and specification management tools, including SPEQ where applicable.
* Coordinate with the dedicated Food Safety department when product quality concerns raise food safety questions; Food Safety retains ownership of food safety programs, regulatory food safety compliance and related incident decisions.

**2. Lead QA Communications and Represent Quality Across the Burger King System**

**Be the trusted, responsive product quality leader for franchisees and the broader Burger King system.**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for product quality assurance matters for franchisees, franchisee leadership groups, Operations and senior business leaders.
* Own proactive, timely and transparent franchisee-facing communication regarding product quality concerns, supplier quality performance, product changes and resolution plans.
* Translate technical findings into clear, practical actions and updates that restaurant operators can understand and use.
* Build feedback loops with franchisees and field teams to identify recurring product quality concerns and incorporate operator input into improvement priorities.
* Lead escalation, investigation, tracking and resolution of significant product quality issues affecting restaurants, with clear accountability and closure.
* Represent product QA in franchisee meetings, advisory forums and leadership discussions; provide concise performance updates and recommendations.
* Partner with Food Safety and the appropriate incident-response leaders on communications where product quality issues intersect with food safety, without assuming ownership of food safety response or decisions.
* Lead, coach and develop the QA team, creating a culture of technical excellence, responsiveness and accountability.

**3. Partner with Culinary, Marketing, Operations and RSI**

**Embed product quality in innovation, sourcing and restaurant execution through strong cross-functional partnership.**

* Act as the primary QA partner to Culinary, Marketing, Operations and Restaurant Services, Inc. (RSI), the Burger King purchasing co-op.
* Collaborate with Culinary and Product Innovation to develop and validate specifications that deliver the intended guest experience consistently at scale.
* Partner with RSI and suppliers to address supplier quality performance, assess sourcing and supplier changes, and support continuous product improvement.
* Support product testing, commercialization and launch readiness by validating product quality, manufacturing consistency and specification compliance.
* Work with Marketing and Culinary to align product quality and sensory performance with brand positioning and guest expectations.
* Evaluate quality implications of ingredient, formulation, packaging, manufacturing and supplier changes, including feasibility for restaurant execution.
* Partner with Operations to translate product standards into restaurant-ready execution and reduce avoidable product variability.
* Coordinate with the Food Safety department for its independent review and approval of food safety considerations in launches, supplier transitions and product changes.
* Balance product quality, operational feasibility and cost considerations while protecting approved brand standards.

**Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Quality Assurance or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in food product quality assurance, food manufacturing, supplier quality management or related disciplines, including demonstrated leadership responsibility.
* Experience managing supplier product specifications, supplier performance, product quality investigations and corrective action programs.
* Strong understanding of food manufacturing, product quality systems, sensory evaluation and analytical testing; ability to work effectively with specialist Food Safety teams.
* Strong analytical and commercial judgment, including the ability to translate technical data into decisions and priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience influencing nontechnical stakeholders and senior leaders.
* Demonstrated cross-functional leadership, relationship-building, issue resolution and people-management capabilities.
* Ability to travel to suppliers, manufacturing facilities, restaurants and business meetings as required.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a large multi-unit restaurant, foodservice or consumer food business, ideally with franchisees.

new_roles.title: Head of Quality
new_roles.description:
Head of Quality

**About Rite Stuff Foods:**

Rite Stuff Foods is a rapidly expanding, frozen appetizer and specialty potato product manufacturer in the United States. We offer a growing range of tasty finger foods which include twice baked potatoes, potato skins, battered and breaded wedges, fried and filled skins, breakfast bites, extruded products, cheese sticks and other assorted batter and breaded vegetables.

Rite Stuff Foods’ parent company, Frostkrone, is based in Rietberg, Germany. Frostkrone is a leading finger food manufacturer, with portfolio companies and manufacturing operations throughout Europe and the United States. We continue to explore expansion in North America and around the world. Our company is driven to innovate and delight consumers & customers worldwide, with high quality, good tasting food.

**Position Overview:**

Reporting to the Managing Director of Rite Stuff Foods, the Head of Quality serves as an important member of the Rite Stuff Foods leadership team and is responsible for establishing, leading, and maintaining a food safety and quality culture throughout the company. The incumbent will ensure adherence to all food safety & quality management programs in the company so that there is no risk to our customers, the general public, and our employees, and our product quality meets or exceeds expectations.

**Responsibilities:**

· Responsible for leading the Quality and Food Safety efforts in the company, and ensure highly disciplined compliance with all regulatory and company-defined food safety systems, procedures, and practices.

· Lead and manage a team of Quality and Food Safety Mangers and Technicians and empower them to take charge and embrace accountability.

· Collaborate with Operations management and with all senior leaders in the safe operation of the facility and driving a “safety first” culture.

· Carry out RCA (root cause analysis), where needed

· Lead preparation for and interaction with third party audits and auditors.

· Liaise closely with regulatory bodies, like the USDA, and key customer QA representatives.

· Ensure proper execution of product Food Safety and Quality testing and reporting.

· Lead the day-to-day implementation of HACCP, QMS, and other supporting pre-requisite programs to meet the SQF Food Safety standards, working closely with the SQF Practitioner.

· Lead the training and development of the Quality Assurance Technicians, scheduling and delegating tasks outlined in the Food Safety Plans, SOP manuals, and other supporting procedures, including monitoring and verification activities to assure products meet regulatory and customer standards.

· Management of the Non-Conforming Equipment and Product Program.

· Provide guidance, leadership, and assistance in problem solving efforts for SOP’s, GMP’s, Quality, Food Safety, and Process Improvement.

· Ensure compliance with FDA/USDA regulations.

· Ensure proper Product Specification management and Document Control management are in place and followed.

· Must have the desire to lead the team and company to the next level of Food Safety, quality and accountability.

· Coordinate recall program, initiate mock recalls, and update as needed

**Qualifications/Experience:**

· Bachelor of science in microbiology, food science or equivalent experience

· 7+ years Quality Assurance experience.

· 5+ years supervisory or management experience.

· Experience in frozen potato or appetizer industry is a plus

· Competent in leading and developing people

· Competent in Quality/Food Safety and Good Laboratory Practices

· Good understanding of hygienic design

· Theoretical and applied knowledge of HACCP/Food Safety Preventative Controls/SQF (or equivalent GFSI scheme)

· Development of SOP’s, Policies, Specifications, etc.

· Internal Auditing

· Microsoft Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint

**Location:** Twin Falls, ID area (incumbent must live in the area)

**Benefits:**

Competitive Salary

Health, Dental, Vision, Life, & LTD Benefits

401(k)

Holidays, paid vacation, and sick days

Opportunity to build your career in a rapidly growing international company

**Status:**

Full-time

*The RSF Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Relocation assistance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

new_roles.title: Quality Director
new_roles.description:
**Quality Director**

**Brunswick Hospital Center (Inpatient Behavioral Healthcare)**

**Amityville, NY**

**Position Summary**

The Quality Director provides strategic leadership for Brunswick Hospital Center’s quality management and performance improvement program. This role is responsible for analyzing trends, identifying systems issues, and driving organization-wide improvement using data provided by the Incident Management / Clinical Risk team.

The position maintains a clear separation of duties so that special investigations and Justice Center case management remain the responsibility of the Incident Management team. The Quality Director ensures alignment with OMH, Joint Commission, CMS, and Justice Center expectations at the systems level.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Quality and Performance Improvement**

* Develop and lead the hospital’s annual Quality and Performance Improvement Plan.
* Design and oversee systems for collecting, analyzing, and reporting quality and incident trend data.
* Chair the Performance Improvement Committee and ensure follow-through on improvement projects.
* Partner with department leaders to establish measurable quality goals and monitor progress.
* Track the implementation and effectiveness of Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) across the organization.
* Support organizational review of sentinel events and high-risk events through systems analysis and monitoring of resulting improvements.

**Collaboration with Incident Management**

* Receive completed investigation findings and case-specific data from the Clinical Risk / Incident Management team.
* Use this information for systems-level analysis and improvement without conducting or duplicating investigations.
* Ensure special investigations and Justice Center case management remain the responsibility of the Incident Management team.

**Compliance and Reporting**

* Prepare and submit required quality and performance improvement reports to internal leadership, the Board, and external agencies (OMH, CMS, Joint Commission) as applicable.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting of quality indicators, trend data, and improvement outcomes.
* Monitor compliance with regulatory reporting timelines and documentation standards related to quality and performance improvement.
* Maintain documentation demonstrating the effectiveness of the quality program for surveys and audits.
* Coordinate the hospital’s response to quality-related findings from external reviews, ensuring corrective actions are tracked to completion.

**Survey Readiness and Regulatory Compliance**

* Coordinate survey readiness activities and maintain ongoing compliance with Joint Commission, CMS, OMH, and related standards.
* Serve as a liaison with OMH on quality and performance improvement matters (distinct from day-to-day incident reporting and Justice Center investigations).
* Oversee systems-level tracking and trending of patient complaints and grievances.

**Leadership and Communication**

* Facilitate communication of quality data and improvement initiatives to medical staff, leadership, and the Board.
* Identify and recommend resources, training, and process changes needed to sustain a culture of safety and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in nursing or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Current RN or NP licensure in New York preferred; other advanced clinical or quality credentials (e.g., CPHQ) considered.
* Minimum of 5 years of progressive quality, performance improvement, or risk management experience in a behavioral health or hospital setting.
* Demonstrated experience with Joint Commission or CMS survey readiness.
* Strong data analysis, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Experience working with OMH or Justice Center expectations at a systems/compliance level preferred.
* Prior supervisory or leadership experience preferred.

* Benefits offered. Salary commensurate with experience.

new_roles.title: Sr Manager Revenue Ops & Billing Governance
new_roles.description:
Club Car boasts a 60+ year history of industry-leading innovation and design, initially focused on golf cars and then expanding to commercial utility vehicles and personal-use transportation.

**GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION**

This newly created leadership position is responsible for building and scaling Club Car’s centralized Billing Governance and Revenue Operations function. The Senior Manager will establish the governance framework, operating model, controls, reporting, and accountability mechanisms necessary to improve invoice accuracy, reduce credits and rebills, improve cash flow performance, and create end-to-end ownership across the Order-to-Cash process. The role serves as a key partner to Commercial, Customer Care, Operations, Supply Chain, IT, Treasury, and Finance and reports to the VP, Global Corporate Controller.

**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Establish and lead Club Car’s centralized Billing Governance and Revenue Operations function.
* Design and document future-state Order-to-Cash processes, ownership matrices, escalation paths, and governance routines.
* Develop KPI dashboards monitoring invoice accuracy, dispute trends, credit/rebill activity, deductions, billing cycle times, DSO, and collection effectiveness.
* Create governance forums that drive accountability across Commercial, Operations, Customer Care, Supply Chain, IT, and Finance.
* Define standardized billing policies, procedures, controls, and performance expectations.
* Identify and eliminate root causes of pricing discrepancies, master data issues, shipping variances, tax errors, and order-entry defects.
* Partner with IT to automate billing workflows, reporting, and exception management processes.
* Lead enterprise-wide initiatives focused on improving billing quality, customer experience, and working capital performance.

***Credit, Rebill & Deduction Governance***

* Own reporting and root-cause analysis related to credit memos, rebills, debit memos, and customer deductions.
* Establish accountability by customer, product, process owner, and business unit.
* Lead recurring cross-functional reviews and corrective-action plans.
* Drive measurable reductions in billing-related disputes and customer claims.

***Financial Controls & Compliance***

* Support close activities for receivables, reserves, deductions, rebates, billing adjustments, and revenue-related accounts.
* Oversee reconciliation governance for key revenue-cycle balance sheet accounts.
* Maintain strong internal-control compliance across billing and receivables processes.
* Support internal and external audits and remediation efforts.

***Leadership & Function Build-Out***

* Build and develop a scalable billing governance organization as business needs evolve.
* Establish training, operating procedures, performance metrics, and management routines.
* Lead organizational change management necessary to implement new processes and controls.
* Champion analytics, automation, AI-enabled tools, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**

* Centralized billing governance structure implemented enterprise-wide.
* Improved first-pass invoice accuracy and reduced manual corrections.
* Reduction in credits, rebills, deductions, and customer disputes.
* Improved DSO, collection performance, and working-capital visibility.
* Sustainable cross-functional accountability for Order-to-Cash performance.

**OTHER DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Maintains safe and productive work environment by assuring the work area is clear of tools, brooms, debris, and other items that may present a hazard.
* Will be required to perform other duties as requested, directed, or assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS FOR THE JOB**

*Education:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.

*Experience:*

* 7+ years of finance, billing operations, revenue operations, accounts receivable, or controllership experience.
* 3+ years of leadership experience with demonstrated success driving change.
* Experience building, transforming, or standardizing business processes in complex organizations.
* Strong knowledge of O2C, billing operations, internal controls, ERP systems, and process governance.

*Preferred:*

* CPA, CMA, MBA, Lean Six Sigma, manufacturing experience, Power BI, or shared-services transformation experience.

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

* Ability to react with appropriate levels of urgency to situations and events that require quick response or turnaround.
* Exceptional organizational, project management, time management, and attention to detail capabilities.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to deal with and manage uncertainty and change.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to complete a high volume of tasks and projects with little or no guidance.
* Demonstrates an ability to teach others how to use various systems effectively.
* Shows an ability to keep up with changing technologies and attend meetings or conferences for ongoing education.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or listen.
* This position may be required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to feel; reach with hand and arms, and stoop, kneel or crouch as needed.

new_roles.description:
**About Oshkosh AeroTech, an Oshkosh company**

**Oshkosh AeroTech is a leading provider of aviation ground support products, gate equipment and airport services to commercial airlines, airports, air-freight carriers, ground handling and military customers. Oshkosh AeroTech offers products that make a difference in people’s lives by supporting those in our communities who do some of the toughest work. They own many of the most trusted brands in the air transportation industry, including LEKTRO®, JetAire®, JetPower®, AmpTekÔ, Jetway®, and more.**

The Oshkosh AeroTech Vice President, Operations will lead operational strategy, execution, and continuous improvement across the Ground Support Equipment (GSE) and Jetway businesses. With dual reporting to the VP of Global Operations & Supply Chain at the Vocational segment and the President of Oshkosh AeroTech, this role is a key member of the Oshkosh AeroTech leadership team, responsible for driving a safety culture, operational efficiency, increasing capacity, manufacturing excellence, and overall business performance.

**YOUR IMPACT**

Safety & Operations Leadership

* Develop, implement, and sustain a world-class safety program that prioritizes team member well-being
* Drive a proactive safety culture by embedding safety into all operational activities, ensuring every team member understands and takes ownership of safety responsibilities.
* In collaboration with VP, Operations & Supply Chain at Vocational segment, develop and implement a comprehensive operations strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Establish KPIs to measure and drive operational performance, efficiency, and cost optimization.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives in production, workflow optimization, and resource allocation.
* Ensure world-class manufacturing capabilities, leveraging Lean, Six Sigma, and automation best practices.
* Develop and implement strategy to increase capacity across AeroTech manufacturing sites.
* Partner with Supply Chain organization to optimize supplier partnerships and inventory management.
* Drive cost reduction initiatives while maintaining high quality and regulatory compliance.

Quality & Compliance

* Ensure all operational processes comply with industry standards, safety regulations, and quality control frameworks.
* Implement best-in-class operational processes to reduce defects, improve reliability, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Drive adherence to ISO and other relevant regulatory requirements.

Financial Management

* Manage budgets, operational expenditures, and capital investments to drive profitability.
* Conduct financial analyses to improve operational decision-making and efficiency.
* Optimize cost structures through strategic sourcing, automation, and process improvements.

Leadership & Talent Development

* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team.
* Foster a culture of safety, continuous improvement, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning and development initiatives to align with business growth and expansion.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, or related field.
* 12+ years of experience in operational leadership, with at least 3 years in a VP or Director-level role.
* Experienced people leader with cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong experience in multi-site manufacturing, supply chain management, and logistics.
* Proven track record in driving operational excellence, lean manufacturing, and six sigma methodologies.
* Strong financial acumen, data-driven decision-making, and process optimization skills.
* Lives the Oshkosh Core Values of We put people first, We do the right thing, We persevere, We are better together
* Demonstrates the Oshkosh Leadership Traits of Inspires Vision and Purpose, Drives Results, Customer Focus, Cultivates Innovation, Fosters Engagement, and Instills Trust

**STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master’s degree in business administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience working with government, military, or defense contracts.
* International or global business experience.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

The Director of Quality, Defense is responsible for overseeing all quality activities, personnel, systems, and performance associated with Defense programs across multiple Karman Space & Defense operating sites. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure all Defense hardware, assemblies, and services meet or exceed contractual, regulatory, and customer requirements. 
 
This position will manage the Defense Quality Engineering organization, supports execution of Defense programs, and ensures consistent application of quality standards and tools across the sector. This leader works in close partnership with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align each site's AS9100 compliant QMS with the emerging enterprise quality architecture and to transition multiple Defense sites toward a unified enterprise certification. 
 
This role is critical in driving disciplined execution, continuous improvement, product integrity, and customer satisfaction within the Defense market segment.

Reports to Vice President, Defense. Functional Partnership with Enterprise Director of Quality (Karman Space & Defense). 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 

* Lead, develop, and manage the Quality Engineering team supporting all Defense programs and projects.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement across Defense Quality functions.
* Serve as the primary Defense quality leader to the VP of Defense and the Defense leadership team.
* Ensure the quality of all Defense hardware, assemblies, engineered systems, and services produced across multiple sites.
* Oversee program quality planning, including inspection strategies, qualification/verification plans, critical characteristics control, product safety considerations, and risk mitigation.
* Review and approve quality requirements for Defense proposals, contracts, and manufacturing plans.
* Drive effective root cause analysis, corrective action, and failure review processes for Defense programs.
* Ensure each Defense site maintains compliance to AS9100, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Provide direct guidance to site Quality Managers/Quality Engineers on QMS implementation, audit readiness, and procedural improvement.
* Support site internal audits, customer audits, DCMA oversight, and third‑party certification audits.
* Partner with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align Defense site QMS structures, documentation, and practices with the enterprise quality framework.
* Support the long-term strategy to transition multiple Defense AS9100 certificates into a unified enterprise certificate.
* Collaborate closely on enterprise initiatives such as configuration management improvements, risk management systems, document control harmonization, supplier quality strategies, and enterprise metrics.

 
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** 

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related technical field preferred
* 10 years of experience in aerospace/defense quality roles preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, and Defense customer quality standards.
* Quality Engineering experience with complex programs including design.

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS**

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, certain positions may require applicants to be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel 0-10% of the time.

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

View our Privacy Policy
