identity_held_roles.title: IT Director of Quality Assurance
identity_held_roles.description:
**ABOUT ETHOS & THE OPPORTUNITY**

Ethos Risk Services is a leading insurance claims investigation and medical management company focused on delivering better data, technology, and insights that help our clients make better decisions. We are continuing to invest in our technology organization and are seeking an experienced engineering leader to help scale how software is built, tested, and delivered.

We are seeking a **full-time Director of Quality Assurance** to own software quality across Ethos, overseeing an outsourced QA team and the processes, tooling, environments, and metrics that prevent defects from reaching production. Our ideal candidate is an experienced, results-driven QA leader who will establish a consistent defect lifecycle, reduce defect aging, implement effective root cause analysis and preventive measures, and improve the reliability of test environments. Within their first year, they will standardize QA tools and processes, integrate AI-based solutions into daily QA operations and performance tracking, and establish a comprehensive KPI framework that drives measurable improvements in software quality, efficiency, and accountability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Lead Outsourced QA Operations:** Direct the day-to-day activities of an outsourced QA team of 8 to10 resources, establishing priorities, performance expectations, and accountability for quality deliverables.
* **Manage Vendor Performance:** Oversee vendor agreements, SLAs, staffing, onboarding, and performance evaluations. Address performance gaps through corrective action and ensure effective knowledge transfer and documentation.
* **Drive Defect Management:** Establish and enforce standardized defect tracking, classification, prioritization, and resolution processes. Lead regular defect triage with engineering and product teams to manage backlogs and identify quality risks.
* **Prevent Production Issues:** Lead structured root cause analysis of production defects, identify recurring failure patterns, and implement preventive measures through improved test coverage, regression testing, and quality gates.
* **Oversee Test Environments:** Partner with DevOps to maintain stable, production-representative QA, staging, and UAT environments, including configuration standards, test data management, and environment availability.
* **Define QA Strategy & Standards:** Develop and continuously improve QA processes across manual, automated, regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing to strengthen quality and consistency.
* **Advance Test Automation:** Evaluate and implement QA tools and automation frameworks, integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and release reliability.
* **Leverage AI-Enabled QA Tools:** Apply AI-based solutions to test generation, defect classification, failure analysis, workload management, and performance monitoring. Evaluate emerging tools and implement solutions that deliver measurable improvements while maintaining appropriate security and accuracy controls.
* **Establish Quality KPIs:** Define and monitor performance metrics, including defect escape rates, resolution times, automation coverage, recurring production incidents, test effectiveness, and vendor SLA adherence.
* **Deliver Executive Reporting:** Produce monthly quality reports and quarterly reviews for the VP of Engineering and CTO, translating performance data into actionable insights, risks, trends, and recommendations.
* **Support Release Readiness:** Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, IT Delivery Leads, and Technical Product Owners to integrate QA into sprint and release planning, assess release quality, and recommend readiness for deployment.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (required).

**Required Experience:**

* 8 to 10 years of progressively greater responsibility in software quality assurance.
* 3 to 4 years in a QA management role leading teams and managers.
* Proven expertise in defect lifecycle management, root cause analysis, and preventive quality practices.
* Hands-on experience establishing and maintaining test environments and test data management practices.
* Strong working knowledge of QA tooling, such as test management (e.g., Xray, Zephyr, TestRail), defect tracking (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps), and automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress).
* Practical experience using AI-based tools in QA or team management, and enthusiasm for expanding their use.
* Experience defining QA KPIs and producing executive-level monthly and quarterly reporting.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into delivery workflows.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Performance, security, or API testing, and a regulated-industry background.
* Certifications: ISTQB Advanced or Test Manager, CSQE, or similar.
* Experience with data visualization or dashboard tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)

**WORKING AT ETHOS**

This is a 100% remote U.S.-based role, offering the flexibility to work from home while remaining closely connected to a collaborative leadership team. Our ideal candidate is available during EST standard business hours. Occasional travel may be required for quarterly or annual leadership meetings and company events.

**Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States and must not require current or future employment sponsorship.**

**Benefits include:** Paid Time Off and Sick Time **|** Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance **|** Short-Term + Long-Term Disability Insurance + Life Insurance **|** 401(k) Matching **|** Employee Referral Bonus Program

At Ethos, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, shape the future of our engineering organization, and help build the systems and processes that support our next stage of growth. **To learn more about Ethos, visit our website:** https://ethosrisk.com/about-us/

*Ethos Risk Services is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.*

Linde Advanced Material Technologies Inc.

**Plant Manager**

Manchester, CT United States | req34380

### **What you will enjoy doing\*** Lead and inspire plant operations, overseeing production, maintenance, quality, safety, and financial performance to deliver exceptional results Drive operational excellence by developing and executing strategies that achieve production goals, reduce waste, enhance quality, and maximize efficiency Promote a world-class safety culture, ensuring compliance with all regulatory, environment and workplace safety standards while protecting employees and operations. Build and develop high-performing teams by fostering a culture of engagement, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning Serve as a strategic leader, balancing day-to operational execution with long-term planning to support sustainable growth and operational excellence **What makes you great** Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or a related discipline required. 7+ years of manufacturing leadership experience with a demonstrated history of delivering operational results, achieving production goals, and leading continuous improvement initiatives Exceptional leadership and communication skills with the ability to inspire, develop, and engage teams while building strong relationships across all levels of the organization Comprehensive understanding of manufacturing processes, equipment, and quality systems, coupled with a commitment to operational excellence Knowledge of safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements with a track record of maintaining compliance and promoting culture of workplace safety Results-oriented mindset with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on leadership in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

**Why you will love working with us**

Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet.
 
 
Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals & energy, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra-high-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state-of-the-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.

**What we offer you!**

At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless. 
 
Linde offers competitive compensation and an outstanding benefits package. Enjoy access to health, dental, disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and vacation, 401(k) matching, pension benefits, an employee discount program, and opportunities for educational and professional growth. Additional compensation may vary depending on the position and organizational level. Build your future with us while making an impact every day! The pay range for this position is: $133,840 - $184,030

**Have we inspired you? Let´s talk about it**

We are looking forward to receiving your complete application.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law. 
 
Linde Advanced Material Technologies Inc. abides by applicable export control laws including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) in accordance with the company's export control procedures. As such, persons considered for this position must be either a U.S. Citizen, Permanent Resident (green card holder) or otherwise classifiable as a U.S. person under relevant regulations. 
 
Linde Advanced Material Technologies Inc. acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development. 
 
\*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Therefore employees assigned may be required to perform additional job tasks required by the manager.

existing_roles.title: Senior Director, Quality
existing_roles.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is looking for an experienced Senior Director of Quality to join our battery manufacturing organization. In this role you will lead the Quality department for Form Energy. Your scope will be company-wide and your team will implement systems and processes that ensure products are designed, manufactured and shipped to the highest levels of performance, reliability, and quality.

This role is for an executive leader with experience developing new technologies and bringing high-volume manufacturing facilities to life. You will provide vision, strategy and leadership to help Form achieve manufacturing scale, cost-reduction, and daily operation execution.

As the key driver for shipping the highest quality products, you will thrive when working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from early R&D to validation testing, pilot builds, and ultimately commercial production of customer-facing products.

*Relocation assistance is available.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Develop and sustain a world-class quality management system powered by a highly-trained, flexible, and proactive staff
* Maintain product risk profiles and manage quality systems to ensure Form Energy is meeting or exceeding risk expectations
* Ensure Form Energy production operations are releasing only conforming products to our customers
* Communicate key risks and opportunities to leadership and provide direction to resolve top issues and drive definitive corrective action
* Plan and efficiently manage Quality resources (labor, OpEx, and CapEx) and report on department performance and needs
* Communicate Form Energy's commitment to quality with internal and external interested parties
* Drive a customer-focused culture anchored by strong individual ownership and accountability

### **What you'll bring:**

* At least 10 years experience in quality, manufacturing, or manufacturing engineering
* At least 5 years in a senior-leader / site-leader quality role, demonstrating a clear record of success in building industry-leading teams that can execute in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Expertise in building Quality Management Systems (e.g., IATF 16949, ISO9001).
* Highly technical background, with a strong foundation in logical reasoning that allows for a steep learning curve and the ability to adapt to new technologies
* Excellent leadership, project management, communication, and organizational skills
* Bachelor’s Degree (or higher) in Engineering

### **Where you'll work:**

This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. **Relocation assistance is available.**

*#LI-Onsite*

*Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.*

*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.*

*To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.*

*If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.*  
  
*Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.*

**Quality Assurance Director – Folding Carton Packaging**

Carton Service CSI, LLC | Shelby, OH | Full-time, salaried (exempt) | On-site with occasional travel

**About Us**

Our site runs a food safety management system built to the SQF Food Safety Code (Edition 9). To learn more about us, visit www.cartonservice.com.

**The Role**

Reporting to the President, the Quality Assurance Director leads quality assurance across all our carton production. You'll make sure our products meet customer specifications and expectations, keep our quality and food safety systems current, and drive cost-effective quality improvements as a key contributor to our strategic plans.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and develop the QA team and oversee the plant quality system
* Review and approve customer specs, and make sure CSI procedures are followed
* Conduct and document internal, supplier and customer audits, manage our FSC and IMS certifications, and serve as backup SQF Practitioner
* Champion GMPs for food-contact packaging, from low-migration inks to hygiene
* Represent us with customers and suppliers, and partner with internal departments, including Sales and Production

**What You Bring**

* College education in a related field (bachelor's degree preferred)
* 5+ years experience working in a GFSI Certified production plant, preferably packaging
* Proven success leading teams, including cross-functional teams
* Strong communication skills with associates, customers, suppliers and regulators
* Organized and results-driven, able to manage multiple priorities and people

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with SQF, BRCGS or another GFSI food safety program
* FSC chain-of-custody or IMS program experience
* SQF Practitioner, HACCP or auditor training; Microsoft Access skills

**Work Environment**

Office work plus time on the production floor (noise, moving machinery; PPE required) and occasional travel to customer and supplier sites. Must be able to stand, walk, bend and kneel frequently and lift up to 25 lbs.

**What We Offer**

* Salary commensurate with experience
* Medical, Rx, dental and vision insurance
* Short- and long-term disability
* 9 paid holidays plus vacation
* 401(k)

**Ready to Apply?**

Apply through Indeed or send your resume and salary expectations to resume@cartonservice.com.

*Carton Service CSI, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Experience:

* quality (GFSI certified): 5 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

existing_roles.title: Director, Quality
existing_roles.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

1. Documents and maintains the company's Quality Management System and verifies its compliance to ISO/TL standards.

2. Documents and maintains the company’s Environmental Management System and verifies its compliance to ISO 14001 standards.

3. Updates documentation as changes are made (procedures, quality and environmental manuals, work instructions, and forms).

4. Maintains quality and environmental records (including, but not limited to Corrective Actions, Audit Results, Employee Training Records, and Document Control Logs).

5. Plans and conducts Management Review Meetings.

6. Performs annual internal audits to determine continuing compliance to ISO standards, as necessary.

7. Works with outside parties (suppliers, customers, and ISO Registrar) on all Quality and Environmental System-related issues.

8. Manage, train, and develop the Quality Department team

9. Responsible for providing employees with ISO training.

**Skills Needed**

* + Strong Reasoning and Critical Thinking Skills (Sound Judgement)
* + High Impact Decision Making (Face Paced Environment)
* + Diplomacy in Difficult Situations
* + Attentive to Detail
* + Strong Presentation Skills & Communication (verbal and non-verbal)
* + Customer/Employee Relations Skills
* + Strong Data Analysis Skills
* + Team Management Skills (Ability to drive staff to action and get results through others)
* + Flexible to Change
* + Strong Organization Skills

  

**Minimum Educational Requirements**

Minimum High School Diploma or GED Required.

existing_roles.description:
Are you a quality leader who enjoys building systems, developing teams, and creating a culture of continuous improvement? Advantic Building Group is seeking a Director of Quality to lead enterprise-wide quality strategy, establish a scalable Quality Management System (QMS), drive ISO 9001 certification efforts, and partner with leaders across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and field operations to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. This is a unique opportunity to build and shape the future of quality within a growing organization.

At Advantic Building Group, we design, fabricate, and install innovative Fiber Reinforced Polymer (FRP) structural systems that help our customers build smarter, safer, and more efficiently.

But what truly sets Advantic apart isn’t just what we build — it’s **how** we work and **who** we work with.

We're a team that values ownership, camaraderie, and curiosity. We roll up our sleeves, tackle challenges together, and support one another along the way. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a quality leader who shares those values and can help strengthen the culture we've built while establishing the systems, processes, and accountability necessary to deliver exceptional quality outcomes for our customers.

**Why Join Advantic?**

* Lead the development of a scalable enterprise-wide Quality Management System (QMS)
* Drive Advantic's ISO 9001 certification journey
* Influence quality across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and field operations
* Build and develop a growing quality organization
* Partner directly with senior leadership to shape strategic initiatives
* Make a visible impact on customer success, operational excellence, and company growth

  

**Role Summary**

The Director of Quality provides strategic leadership for quality across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, assembly, and field operations. This role is responsible for developing and executing Advantic Building Group's quality strategy, building a scalable Quality Management System (QMS), leading ISO 9001 certification efforts, and driving continuous improvement throughout the organization.

This leader partners closely with operations, engineering, supply chain, and project teams to reduce defects, improve process performance, strengthen customer confidence, and support the company's growth objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Leadership and Strategic Planning**

* Develop and execute a quality roadmap aligned with business growth, customer commitments, operational risks, and manufacturing and construction requirements; set annual objectives, priorities, and resource needs, including staffing, inspection equipment, and quality technology.
* Report quality performance, emerging risks, and cost of poor quality (scrap, rework, field repairs, returns, warranty) to senior leadership with clear owners, deadlines, and escalation expectations, and partner with Operations and Delivery to reduce it.

**Quality Management Systems (QMS) & ISO 9001 Leadership**

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve Advantic's Quality Management System (QMS), while leading ISO 9001 certification readiness, certification audits, surveillance audits, and recertification activities.
* Build a scalable, practical Quality Management System that enables operational consistency, supports growth, improves customer satisfaction, and achieves ISO 9001 certification.
* Govern document, configuration, and revision control across engineering drawings, submittals, production information, and field documentation, and ensure quality records are reliable and accessible across ERP, MES, and document systems with defined data ownership.

**Manufacturing Quality, Process Control & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish inspection and test plans, acceptance criteria, and release controls for incoming materials, in-process fabrication, final assembly, packaging, and pre-shipment verification, ensuring products conform to approved drawings, engineering requirements, customer specifications, and applicable contractual and industry requirements.
* Partner with Operations on specification review, design reviews, process risk assessments, first-build validation, and readiness for new or changed products and processes; coordinate qualified technical resources when specialized expertise is needed.
* Define traceability, inspection records, measuring equipment controls, calibration, and measurement method validation appropriate to risk and application.
* Establish controls for FRP materials and structural assemblies, including storage, handling, fabrication, and special processes.

**Corrective Actions, Root Cause Analysis & Quality Improvement**

* Lead the enterprise nonconformance and corrective action process, including containment, material disposition, root cause analysis, escalation management, and verification of corrective action effectiveness across internal, supplier, customer, and field-related issues.
* Exercise authority under approved procedures to quarantine material, hold shipments, or stop affected work when conformity is in question; coordinate technical dispositions and obtain required customer approval for concessions or deviations, while maintaining independence of quality decisions.

**Supplier, Subcontractor, & Field Quality Management**

* Partner with Supply Chain to establish supplier qualification, approval, audit, and performance monitoring, including quality requirements for outsourced services and subcontracted work, and maintain approval status in the approved supplier system.
* Ensure certifications, traceability, inspection evidence, and customer requirements are flowed down to suppliers and verified.
* Lead supplier corrective actions and improvement plans, and support cost recovery within established commercial authority.
* Develop the field quality program for construction management and data center white space work, including project quality plan templates, inspection and test plan requirements, hold and witness points, and documentation standards that on-site QC managers must follow.
* Set expectations for, train, and hold on-site QC managers accountable to the program through project kickoffs, periodic field audits, and review of inspection records, field non-conformances, and punch list and turnover documentation.
* Serve as the escalation point for field quality issues and the senior quality contact for customers and third-party inspectors during audits and handover.

  

**Performance Measures**

* Establish baselines, targets, and reporting definitions with leadership. Measures include first-pass yield, scrap and rework, cost of poor quality, nonconformance recurrence and closure time, corrective action effectiveness, supplier performance, customer complaints, field deficiencies, audit completion, calibration compliance, and progress against the quality roadmap.

  

**People Leadership and Shared Accountability**

* Lead hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and development of quality personnel, with training matrices, competency expectations, and succession plans.
* Partner with operational leaders to build quality awareness across the organization, and hold process owners accountable through agreed governance and escalation, reinforcing that each department owns the quality of its work.
* Model Ownership, Camaraderie, and Curiosity through clear expectations, respectful challenge, and consistent follow-through.

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, quality, or a related discipline, or equivalent directly relevant experience.
* Ten or more years of progressive quality experience, including five or more years leading a quality team or function in manufacturing or a comparable technical environment.
* Demonstrated success building, implementing, or significantly improving Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Experience leading ISO 9001 implementation, certification readiness, and managing internal, customer, and third-party audits.
* Proven results developing people, leading change across departments, and reducing defects, repeat failures, or quality-related costs.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and inspection requirements; practical knowledge of measurement systems, traceability, process controls, and structured problem-solving.
* Experience using ERP, MES, electronic quality systems, or comparable tools to establish dependable workflows and actionable reporting.
* Ability to communicate clearly with customers, frontline employees, and senior leaders; make sound decisions under pressure; and resolve competing quality, schedule, and business priorities.

  

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience with FRP or composite products, structural fabrication, engineered assemblies, construction quality, or mission-critical and data center projects.
* Experience connecting manufacturing quality with field installation, subcontractor oversight, customer acceptance, and project turnover.
* ASQ CMQ/OE, CQE, or CQA certification; ISO 9001 lead auditor qualification; or Lean Six Sigma training with demonstrated application.

  

**Physical demands**

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to communicate effectively through speaking and listening. The role typically involves prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, and lift or move objects up to 15 pounds.

*Advantic Building Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

The Director collaborates with leadership, providers, and staff to promote a culture of continuous improvement, patient safety, and accountability. They oversee performance improvement initiatives, incident reporting systems, compliance activities, and risk mitigation strategies to enhance patient outcomes and organizational effectiveness. This position also plays a critical role in integrating culturally responsive care into quality frameworks, supporting health equity, and ensuring services reflect the values, traditions, and needs of the Tribal population served.
  
  
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  
  

* Develop, implement, and oversee LHC’s Compliance, Quality Risk programs, policies, and procedures related to standards of conduct; healthcare laws; billing and reimbursement; fraud, waste, and abuse prevention; privacy and security; quality improvement and other compliance risk areas.
* Lead and facilitate internal committees to drive strategic planning for these programs, setting long- and short-term goals, operational plans, and performance measures.
* Conduct organization-wide quality and risk assessments to identify, prioritize, and mitigate compliance risks and improve overall patient outcomes.
* Monitor compliance with healthcare laws, CMS/OIG regulations, HIPAA/HITECH, and Tribal requirements.
* Oversee sanction screening of employees, contractors, and vendors; ensure organization-wide training on sanction monitoring processes. Ensure credentialing, privileging and provider enrollment program is effective.

* Serve as the organizational liaison with regulatory agencies during audits, investigations, and compliance inquiries.
* Lead and mentor others in root cause analysis (RCA), healthcare failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) and hazard vulnerability analysis (HVA) teams. Summarize risk management and patient safety data for appropriate evaluation and risk trend analysis.
* Maintain detailed records of compliance efforts, investigative outcomes, and corrective action plans.
* Provide written and verbal compliance reports to executive management, internal Quality Committee, the Board Compliance Committee and the LHC Board of Directors.
* Develop and administer a robust, organization-wide compliance training and education program in conjunction managers and the HR department.
* Lead communication initiatives to promote compliance awareness, ethical conduct, quality management and transparent reporting.

Quality Management certification preferred.
  
  
MANDATORY KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES and COMPETENCIES with proficiency levels
  
  
Ethical Integrity Professionalism — Advanced
  
  
1. Demonstrates unwavering commitment to confidentiality, transparency, and ethical conduct.
  
  
2. Consistently models organizational values and establishes an ethical compliance culture.
  
  
3. Guides organizational decision-making through an ethics-centered approach.
  
  
Regulatory Compliance Expertise — Advanced
  
  
1. Interprets and applies federal, state, and Tribal healthcare regulations with precision.
  
  
2. Advises leadership on complex regulatory issues and emerging compliance risks.
  
  
3. Ensures organizational alignment with OIG, CMS, HIPAA/HITECH, and other regulatory standards.
  
  
Analytical Critical Thinking — Advanced
  
  
1. Uses advanced analytical methods to identify trends, risks, and system vulnerabilities.
  
  
2. Evaluates complex scenarios, synthesizes large volumes of information, and provides clear recommendations.
  
  
3. Leads continuous improvement initiatives using data-driven insights.
  
  
Investigation Problem-Solving — Advanced
  
  

* Conducts or oversees thorough investigations into compliance concerns.
* Demonstrates strong evidence analysis skills and draws objective, well-supported conclusions.
* Designs and monitors corrective action plans to ensure sustainable resolution

Leadership Influence — Advanced
  
  
1. Leads cross-functional teams and committees with confidence and clarity.
  
  
2. Influences organizational behavior through effective communication, coaching, and ethical leadership.
  
  
3. Builds trust and credibility with executives, clinical leaders, and staff.
  
  
Communication Interpersonal Effectiveness — Advanced
  
  
1. Clearly communicates complex regulatory concepts to varied audiences.
  
  
2. Prepares high-quality written reports and delivers professional presentations.

Training Education Development — Intermediate to Advanced
  
  
1. Designs tailored compliance training programs for all workforce levels.
  
  
2. Assesses training effectiveness and adjusts content to address knowledge gaps.

Project Program Management — Intermediate to Advanced
  
  
1. Manages multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  
  
2. Develops strategic and operational plans for the Compliance Program.
  
  
3. Implements structured processes for tracking progress and outcomes.
  
  
Risk Management Continuous Improvement — Advanced
  
  
1. Conducts comprehensive risk assessments and ongoing monitoring activities.
  
  
2. Identifies compliance vulnerabilities and implements preventative strategies.
  
  
3. Leads continuous improvement efforts across systems, policies, and internal controls.

LHC will apply “Indian Preference” as an employment criterion and not a “racial classification.” The Laguna Healthcare Corporation has implemented a Tribal Preference in Employment Policy. Pursuant to this Policy, applicants who possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities required by this position, and who are enrolled members of the Pueblo of Laguna will be given primary preference in hiring and employment for this position. Members of other Federally recognized Indian Tribes will be given secondary preference for hiring and employment after providing proof of Tribal membership.
  
  
CONFIDENTIALITY

BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION

DRUG SCREENING
  
  
All applicants must successfully pass a pre-employment drug screening prior to beginning employment and will be subject to random drug testing

existing_roles.description:
Position Title: Quality Manager

Reports To: Plant Manager

Position Summary

The Quality Manager is responsible for the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS) and overall product quality performance. This role focuses on ensuring compliance with AS9100 requirements, driving corrective actions and maintaining consistent quality standards across all operations.

The primary focus of this role is ownership of the QMS, proactive quality leadership and ensuring quality standards are effectively executed in both production and administrative processes.

Project Prioritization & Scope

· Ensure the Quality Management System is maintained, compliant and effectively implemented across the organization.

· Prioritize and drive corrective actions related to customer complaints, internal defects and supplier issues.

· Ensure timely completion of PPAPs, first article inspections and other customer-required quality deliverables.

· Balance time between production floor engagement and administrative quality responsibilities based on business needs.

· Proactively identify quality risks in production and implement containment and corrective actions.

· Prioritize improvement activities based on quality performance metrics, including customer returns, scrap and supplier performance.

· Coordinate with Production, Engineering and other departments to address quality-related risks and issues.

· Ensure nonconforming material is properly controlled, documented and dispositioned in a timely manner.

Key Responsibilities

· Own and maintain the AS9100 Quality Management System, ensuring compliance and effectiveness.

· Lead internal audits and coordinate external audits, including customer and registrar audits.

· Monitor quality performance and address issues impacting product quality in real time.

· Communicate quality performance, risks and significant issues to leadership in a timely manner.

· Perform hands-on inspection of parts as needed to verify quality standards and reinforce expectations.

· Engage with production employees through brief training and coaching conversations to improve quality awareness and execution.

· Lead and drive corrective actions (8D, CARs, SCARs) across departments, ensuring timely completion and effectiveness.

· Serve as the primary point of contact for customer quality issues and responses.

· Oversee supplier performance, including quality, corrective actions and on-time delivery.

· Own, monitor and drive improvement of key quality performance metrics including customer returns, internal scrap and supplier performance.

· Support or perform technical validation activities such as dimensional inspection and laser scanning as required.

· Ensure inspection processes (incoming, in-process, final) are effective and consistently executed.

Implementation & Sustainment

· Ensure quality processes and standards are consistently followed and sustained across all departments.

· Monitor effectiveness of corrective actions and escalate when issues are not resolved.

· Verify that process changes, corrective actions and improvements are properly implemented and maintained.

· Ensure documentation and records within the QMS remain current, accurate and controlled.

Quality System & Process Execution Focus

· Oversee adherence to quality standards across all manufacturing processes.

· Monitor process compliance and identify deviations from established quality requirements.

· Ensure nonconforming material is clearly identified, segregated and controlled.

· Prevent shipment of nonconforming product through effective inspection and process controls.

Training & Cross-Functional Collaboration

· Provide training, coaching and guidance to employees regarding quality standards and expectations.

· Conduct brief, on-the-floor interactions to reinforce quality awareness and correct behaviors.

· Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance and other departments to resolve quality issues.

· Work with Purchasing and suppliers to address supplier-related quality concerns.

· Drive accountability for quality performance across all departments.

· Conduct regular team communication meetings and employee development discussions to support accountability, alignment and performance.

Role Scope & Responsibilities

The following clarifies the scope of this role in relation to other functions within the organization:

· This role owns the Quality Management System and is accountable for its effectiveness and compliance with AS9100 requirements.

· This role is responsible for proactively identifying, initiating and driving corrective actions across all departments.

· This role owns quality outcomes and is responsible for ensuring completion of quality-related activities, regardless of which function performs the work.

· This role is responsible for maintaining a consistent presence on the production floor to verify quality and reinforce standards.

· This role is expected to proactively identify, escalate and drive resolution of quality risks without requiring direction from others.

· This role supports production through quality oversight but does not own production output or scheduling.

· This role is responsible for driving accountability to quality standards across all departments and providing leadership, direction and oversight to quality personnel as organizational needs evolve.

· This role supports product validation activities such as PPAP and inspection but does not own process design, which is the responsibility of the Process Engineer.

· This role is accountable for ensuring nonconforming material processes are followed but relies on cross-functional support for execution of material movement and disposition actions.

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you okay with working in an office setting and on the production floor?

Experience:

* Quality management: 5 years (Required)
* Quality audits: 5 years (Required)

Location:

* Preston, IA 52069 (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Preston, IA 52069 (Required)

Work Location: In person

**ABOUT ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY SYSTEMS COMPANY**

Advanced Technology Systems Company designs and builds mission-critical systems that protect U.S. warfighters, national infrastructure, and allied partners. Our solutions are fielded by the Department of War (DOW) and the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), as well as the most demanding military end users in the world, where performance, quality, and on-time delivery are non-negotiable. As our backlog of multi-million-dollar government programs grows, we are investing in the people, automation, and facilities needed to deliver at scale.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are seeking a proven Vice President of Manufacturing to lead end-to-end manufacturing and materials operations across our government and defense program portfolio. This executive will provide strategic and operational leadership for production, manufacturing engineering, quality, procurement, and material-flow functions—including kitting, receiving, shipping, and storeroom operations—and oversee the manufacturing planning and procurement systems that enable execution. The role owns plant operations, factory overhead, process automation, throughput, process controls, and facilities, turning contract commitments into high-quality hardware delivered on schedule and within cost. This is a hands-on executive role for a leader who has scaled defense production and integrated manufacturing, quality, and supply functions to support sustained growth. You will sit on the senior operations leadership team and have a direct impact on program margins, customer confidence, and the company’s growth.

**ORGANIZATIONAL SCOPE**

The position is intended to provide executive-level oversight of the integrated functions and capabilities required to plan, source, build, inspect, and deliver products. Functions within the role’s organizational scope are expected to include hourly assembly and test personnel; manufacturing engineering; quality; procurement; and materials operations, including kitting, receiving, shipping, and storeroom management. The role also provides functional ownership and governance of the manufacturing resource planning and procurement systems (including Costpoint MRP and Purchasing), in coordination with IT and Finance as appropriate.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Program Production Execution**

* **Contract delivery: Own manufacturing execution for multi-million-dollar DOW and government contracts, meeting cost, schedule, and quality requirements from LRIP through full-rate production.**
* Integrated planning: Lead integrated production and materials planning with Program Management, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain; align master production schedules, procurement plans, material availability, capacity plans, and Earned Value (EVMS) reporting.
* **Production readiness:** Lead design-for-manufacturability reviews, PRRs, and transition-to-production activities for new multi-million dollar programs.

**Plant Operations & Financial Performance**

* **Factory leadership:** Lead plant managers, production supervisors, manufacturing engineers, and hourly workforce across shifts; build a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* **Cost ownership:** Manage the manufacturing budget, labor, and factory overhead; drive cost-reduction initiatives that protect program margin and improve competitiveness on future bids.
* **Throughput:** Set and deliver targets for yield, cycle time, OEE, first-pass yield, and on-time delivery; remove bottlenecks and balance lines.

**Materials, Procurement & Quality**

**Procurement leadership:** Provide strategic oversight of procurement, supplier performance, sourcing, and material availability; align purchasing priorities with production schedules, program requirements, and cost objectives.

**Materials flow:** Oversee kitting, receiving, shipping, and storeroom operations to ensure accurate inventory control, timely material delivery to production, and effective control of work in process.

**Quality leadership:** Provide leadership and accountability for manufacturing quality, corrective and preventive action, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement; ensure quality is integrated into production planning and execution.

**Planning systems:** Own the business processes and functional requirements for manufacturing resource planning and procurement systems, including Costpoint MRP and Purchasing; drive data integrity, effective system utilization, and coordination with IT and Finance.

**Automation & Process Controls**

* **Automation strategy:** Define and execute a multi-year automation roadmap, including robotics, automated test, and MES/ERP integration, with clear ROI.
* Quality & process discipline: Lead the quality function and establish statistical process control, configuration management, corrective action, and documentation compliant with AS9100, ITAR, DFARS, and customer quality clauses.
* **Lean & Six Sigma:** Deploy Lean manufacturing and Six Sigma practices to reduce variation, scrap, rework, and cost of poor quality.

**Facilities Management**

* **Compliance & audits:** Serve as the senior manufacturing representative for DCMA, customer, and third-party audits and source inspections.

existing_roles.description:
Kentucky Trailer

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

Job Title: Director of Operations
  
Division: Kentucky Trailer  
Location: Louisville, KY- 3 site locations  
Reports to: President, Kentucky Trailer  
FLSA: Exempt  
  
This position has multiple direct reports across 3 sites. Current direct reports include Operations Manager, 7 Team Leaders, and a Manufacturing Engineer/Facilities Manager. This position requires local travel between the 3 sites in Louisville.  
  
Kentucky Trailer has been building in Louisville since 1879, when it was founded as the Kentucky Wagon Manufacturing Company. Today it designs and builds custom trailers and truck bodies for moving and storage, snack food distribution, package delivery, and specialty markets such as mobile medical, government, and motorsports. Most of what we build is engineered to order rather than off the shelf, which makes our operations both challenging and rewarding to lead.  
  
The Director of Operations leads all day-to-day manufacturing operations and is accountable for Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, People, and Productivity results. The role owns the manufacturing operating budget, develops frontline leaders, and builds a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Works closely with Materials, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, and Commercial Sales to make sure production plans are executable and customer commitments are met. The workforce is non-union.

**Position Key Accountabilities:**

### **Safety**

* Create and sustain a Safety First and Always culture, with every employee understanding their personal responsibility for a safe workplace.
* Enforce safety policies, procedures and safe work practices at every level of the organization.
* Make sure hazards, near misses and incidents are addressed promptly, with root causes corrected.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA and environmental requirements and lead continuous improvement toward an incident-free workplace.

### **Manufacturing performance and planning**

* Lead daily manufacturing activities to meet production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Set clear daily, weekly and monthly expectations for each production area, and align labor and resources to requirements.
* Identify production constraints and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Materials so schedules are executable and escalate shortages before they affect production.
* Support point-of-use inventory, Kanban, vendor-managed inventory and other Lean material strategies where appropriate.

### **Quality**

* Build a culture where quality is owned at the point of manufacture and the next operation is treated as the customer.
* Ensure compliance with manufacturing standards, specifications, work instructions and quality procedures.
* Partner with Engineering to drive root-cause corrective action and reduce defects, rework, warranty exposure and cost of poor quality.

### **Lean and operational excellence**

* Champion Lean Manufacturing using 5S, Standard Work, Visual Management, Kaizen and structured problem solving.
* Establish a disciplined management cadence of daily production meetings, visual boards, KPI reviews and structured follow-up.
* Ensure standard work is documented, followed and continuously improved.
* Drive measurable improvement in labor productivity, cycle time, throughput, material flow, space utilization and manufacturing cost.
* Lead automation and capital initiatives that improve safety, quality, productivity and cost.

### **Financial performance and cost**

* Own the manufacturing operating budget and take part in the annual budget and monthly forecasts.
* Manage to labor, overhead and operating cost targets, including direct labor productivity, overtime and indirect labor.
* Ensure accuracy in both labor reporting and BOM usages
* WIP accuracy, and operational support for cycle counts and physical inventories.
* Partner with Finance to analyze manufacturing variances and carry out corrective actions.
* Prepare ROI justifications for capital requests and track whether completed projects deliver the promised return.

### **Maintenance and facilities**

* Ensure preventive maintenance programs maximize equipment uptime and extend asset life.
* Improve utilization of equipment, facilities and manufacturing capacity.

### **Leadership and people development**

* Lead, coach and develop managers, team leaders and employees across the operation.
* Set annual performance goals and development plans and hold leaders accountable for results.
* Build frontline leaders' capability in problem solving, waste elimination and employee accountability.
* Build organizational depth through hiring, succession planning and cross-training.
* Communicate regularly with employees about performance, company expectations, policies and priorities.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Manufacturing or another technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 10 years in manufacturing with a proven record of success and increasing responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years leading multi-site operations through managers and leaders.
* Demonstrated record of improving safety performance
* Lean Manufacturing experience or certification, with measurable results in efficiency improvement and cost reduction.
* Demonstrated P&L or operating budget accountability.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at once.
* Willingness to live and work in the greater Louisville, KY area.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Trailer, truck body or similar fabrication, welding and assembly experience.
* Experience in high-mix, custom build-to-order manufacturing.
* MBA or other financial education.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

This role works in both office and manufacturing plant settings, with exposure to noise, welding, painting and moving equipment. Required PPE must be worn on the production floor. The role regularly requires walking and standing for extended periods.

Employment is contingent on successful completion of a background check and drug screen.

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

existing_roles.description:
Responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and continuous improvement of a specialized magnet wire manufacturing plant. Directs all plant operations to achieve excellence in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and employee engagement. Leads cross-functional teams across production, maintenance, engineering, quality, supply chain, and human resources to ensure reliable operations, compliance with regulatory requirements, and achievement of business objectives. The ideal candidate brings strong manufacturing leadership experience, a disciplined approach to problem-solving, and a proven ability to build a high-performance culture in a fast-paced industrial environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead all plant operations with full accountability for safety, environmental compliance, quality, productivity, delivery performance, and cost management.
* Drive a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with OSHA, environmental regulations, company policies, and safe work practices; lead incident prevention, investigation, and corrective actions.
* Oversee the production of magnet wire products, including coordination of drawing, annealing, insulating, enameling, winding, packaging, and related support processes, as applicable to the facility.
* Ensure production schedules are achieved while maintaining customer specifications, quality standards, and on-time delivery requirements.
* Direct plant leadership across production, maintenance, engineering, quality, warehousing, and support functions to achieve operational goals.
* Develop and execute plant operating plans, budgets, capital plans, and continuous improvement initiatives aligned with company strategy.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators such as safety performance, scrap, yield, throughput, downtime, labor efficiency, customer complaints, and overall equipment effectiveness.
* Lead efforts to reduce waste, improve process capability, optimize equipment utilization, and control manufacturing costs.
* Partner with engineering and quality teams to maintain process discipline and product consistency for magnet wire applications requiring precise electrical, dimensional, and coating performance.
* Ensure preventive and predictive maintenance systems are effective and that critical equipment reliability is sustained.
* Support new product introductions, process changes, and capital projects to improve capacity, quality, and operational performance.
* Build a culture of accountability, teamwork, communication, and employee involvement through visible leadership and regular plant presence.
* Hire, coach, develop, and evaluate plant leadership and workforce talent to strengthen bench depth and succession planning.
* Collaborate with supply chain, customer service, finance, human resources, and corporate leadership to align plant performance with business needs.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action efforts for operational issues, quality concerns, and customer escalations.
* Ensure compliance with company systems, audits, documentation requirements, and applicable customer or industry standards.
* Prepare and present plant performance updates, forecasts, and improvement plans to senior leadership.
* Promote housekeeping, 5S, and disciplined operating standards across the facility.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum 7–10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including experience leading teams in a plant or large production environment.
* Magnet wire and/or copper forming into shaped wire (rectangular and squares) manufacturing experience preferred.
* Demonstrated success managing safety, quality, production, maintenance, and cost performance in a manufacturing setting.
* Strong knowledge of lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and structured problem-solving methods.
* Experience with budgeting, financial performance management, and capital planning.
* Strong leadership, communication, coaching, and team development skills.
* Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make sound operational decisions.
* Working knowledge of quality systems, process control, and manufacturing compliance requirements.
* Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems and standard business software.

### **Description**

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled **Plant Manager** to oversee and manage all aspects of multi-site plant operations, ensuring efficient production, high-quality standards, and a safe working environment.  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, proven experience in managing manufacturing plants, and a thorough understanding of operational strategies, including safety, budgeting, and human resource management. The Plant Manager will also be responsible for ensuring production goals are met, maintaining plant facilities, and continuously improving processes to maximize efficiency

### **How You Will Help**

  

* Lead and manage daily operations of the manufacturing plant to meet production schedules, ensure product quality, and achieve on-time delivery.
* Partner with EHS to ensure safety, health, and environmental regulations, including local, state, and federal safety standards.
* Develop and implement strategic plans for operational efficiency, resource allocation, and process improvements.
* Manage plant budgets and financial statements, ensuring cost-effective operations while meeting financial goals.
* Maintain and upgrade plant facilities and equipment, ensuring they are in optimal working condition; oversee necessary repairs, replacements, and adjustments.
* Monitor production activities, ensuring adherence to quality standards and safety protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Collaborate with engineering, quality, and supply chain teams to optimize production processes and implement lean manufacturing principles.
* Create and foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement, leading by example and building strong relationships with team members.
* Implement and monitor inventory management strategies, ensuring proper material flow and minimizing waste.
* Develop, mentor, and manage staff, providing training and development opportunities to enhance skills and performance.
* Ensure timely communication and coordination between departments to meet production targets and business objectives.
* Identify and resolve operational issues, making data-driven decisions to improve plant efficiency and productivity.
* Perform other duties as assigned by senior management
* Travel up to 10% domestically, including quarterly visits to company facilities in Pennsylvania and Texas to support project execution and cross-functional collaboration.

  

### **What You Will Bring**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience working in a custom manufacturing environment, including knowledge of assembly, fabrication, welding, and machining processes
* A minimum of 10 years of experience in plant operations, with at least 5 years in a management role.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, strategic planning, and financial statements.
* Strong leadership abilities with proven experience in team building, decision-making, and people management.
* In-depth knowledge of manufacturing processes, equipment, and safety standards.
* Familiarity with lean manufacturing, supply chain management, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBA or advanced degree in a related field.
* Certification or experience with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or supply chain management.
* Working knowledge of industry codes and standards, including TOSHA and other health and safety regulations.

  

### **About Reliable Safety and Flow Corporation**

Bringing together more than 175 years of innovation, quality, and customer commitment under one name and one promise.

The company was forged in 1850, as American industry was being connected by pipe, valves, fittings, and the skilled people who knew how to put them in the right place. More than 175 years later, that heritage lives in ASC Engineered Solutions, a comprehensive pipe preparation, joining, hanging and flow-management portfolio supporting the people who build and maintain commercial buildings, industrial facilities, infrastructure, and critical systems. A house of brands, Anvil, Gruvlok, Sharpe, SCI, and ABZ, unified as ASC in 2019, and the portfolio has grown in the years since.

In 1920, Reliable Automatic Sprinkler started doing one thing exceptionally well: building the fire safety systems that protect people and property. Sprinklers, valves, and accessories, made in the United States. More than a century later, the discipline has not changed. A century of American-made fire protection products, with multi-generational customer relationships and multi-decade specifications. A century of protecting what matters the most.

**Two legacies. One Future.**

(MNAe). Reporting to both the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and the Quality Control Head of Group (HOG), the HOD establishes quality strategy, objectives, governance, and priorities; oversees MIP process quality, supplier quality, customer quality, and overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production; leads major investigations and escalations; and ensures that containment, root cause, corrective action, and effectiveness verification are completed to protect customers, stabilize production, and prevent recurrence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** *(To perform within this position successfully, the incumbent must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned.)*

* Represent the Quality Control function in executive reviews, customer meetings, supplier escalations, audits, and other strategic business discussions.
* Promote a proactive quality culture, continuous improvement, customer focus, supplier accountability, and workplace safety.
* Define decision-making and escalation authority and make timely quality decisions, including containment, production hold, shipment hold, sorting, rework, and controlled release recommendations when required.
* Supervise, coach, and develop Quality Control HOSs, managers, Assistant Managers, Specialists, and other assigned quality personnel.
* Evaluate departmental capability, workload, staffing, competency, and training needs and allocate resources based on business and quality risk.
* Plan and oversee internal, supplier, customer, and certification audits and ensure timely closure and effectiveness of follow-up actions.
* Lead cross-functional quality decisions and collaboration with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering, Maintenance, Logistics, Purchasing, Supplier Quality, Program Management, and other relevant functions.
* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, internal policies, and applicable quality requirements.
* Develop and continuously improve quality management systems, procedures, standards, inspection controls, traceability, rework controls, NCR processes, Quality Alerts, and escalation processes.
* Review and approve daily, weekly, and monthly departmental quality reports, quality trends, KPIs, recurring issue analysis, and improvement priorities.
* Report quality performance, significant risks, customer and supplier escalations, resource needs, and recovery status directly to the CEO and executive management.
* Maintain executive-level relationships with OEM customers and lead quality communication, claims, audits, investigations, corrective action submissions, and escalation response.
* Maintain management-level communication with outsourcing partners and OEM customers regarding ICCU and HPCU production quality performance, major issues, investigation results, corrective action status, and quality recovery plans.

* Ensure issues are properly classified as internal process, supplier, design, logistics, or customer-interface related and assign clear ownership for resolution.
* Lead and approve major investigations involving internal defects, supplier-related issues, customer complaints, field concerns, and quality escalations.
* Direct MIP process quality, supplier quality, and customer quality activities across Stator, Motor, Reducer, PE System, Inverter, and related electrified powertrain products.
* Direct overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production, including outsourcing-partner performance, process controls, change points, audits, defect trends, containment, corrective actions, escalation, and effectiveness verification.

**Senior Manager – Reman & Refurb Operations**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Senior Manager – Reman & Refurb Operations leads the development, execution, and growth of SANY America’s component remanufacturing and full-machine refurbishment operations. This position oversees shop performance, safety, quality, cost, inventory, suppliers, and dealer support while building a scalable, profitable operation that improves machine uptime and lifecycle value.

With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase their market share.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Business Strategy & Operations**

* Develop and execute the U.S. remanufacturing and refurbishment roadmap, including future certified refurbished equipment programs.

* Direct production planning, technician utilization, shop capacity, workflows, turnaround times, and performance standards.

* Build and coach technical and operations teams, establishing clear ownership, training, and accountability.

**Remanufacturing & Refurbishment**

* Standardize machine inspection, teardown, repair, component replacement, testing, cosmetic restoration, and final acceptance.

* Expand viable remanufacturing offerings for engines, hydraulics, powertrain, electronics, and other high-value assemblies.

* Establish documented repair procedures, quality gates, testing standards, failure analysis, and corrective actions.

**Financial & Inventory Management**

* Own operating budgets, rebuild costs, labor standards, margin performance, scrap reduction, and repair-versus-replace decisions.

* Develop core return, valuation, salvage, used-component, and reman inventory controls to improve recovery and reduce working capital.

* Track operational and financial KPIs, including cycle time, capacity, first-pass quality, revenue, and profitability.

**Suppliers, Dealers & Cross-Functional Support**

* Manage outside rebuild suppliers and technical partners against quality, cost, warranty, and lead-time expectations.

* Partner with Service, Parts, Warranty, Product, Sales, Finance, and dealers to support customer uptime and refurbishment opportunities.

* Support certified refurbished equipment programs through condition grading, inspection documentation, and warranty coordination.

**Safety & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain a safe, organized, compliant shop with appropriate PPE, equipment controls, and safe work practices.

* Implement Lean, 5S, standard work, visual management, root cause analysis, and ongoing process improvements.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

* 12+ years of progressive experience in remanufacturing, refurbishment, heavy equipment, automotive, industrial manufacturing, service operations, or a related field.

* 6+ years of direct people-management or operations-leadership experience.

* Strong understanding of engines, hydraulics, powertrain, electrical systems, and heavy equipment troubleshooting.

* Proven ability to manage production, quality, inventory, capacity, costs, KPIs, and financial performance.

* Strong communication, problem-solving, cross-functional leadership, and analytical skills.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience launching or expanding remanufacturing, machine rebuild, refurbishment, or certified pre-owned operations.

* Construction or off-highway equipment experience, including supplier and third-party rebuild partner management.

* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, ERP, inventory, service, and warranty system experience.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

**OFFICE + OPERATIONS WORK ENVIRONMENT**

This role is primarily office-based with regular work in remanufacturing, refurbishment, and equipment service areas. Duties may involve extended computer use, standing, walking, and observing or inspecting heavy machinery, tools, and shop operations. Exposure to noise, moving equipment, and varying temperatures may occur. Required personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel to SANY facilities, suppliers, dealers, and customer sites as business needs require.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience.

* Medical, dental, and vision

* Paid Time Off

* 401(k) savings plans

* Health Savings Account (HSA)

* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

* Company paid STD and LTD benefits

* Life Insurance

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**

SANY America is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local law.

**DRUG AND ALCOHOL-FREE WORKPLACE NOTICE**

SANY America is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a drug and alcohol-free workplace consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Applicants may be required to complete pre-employment screenings, including drug and/or alcohol testing, as a condition of employment where permitted by applicable law. Testing requirements, employment practices, and workplace policies may vary based on work location, position responsibilities, business necessity, workplace safety considerations, customer requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable regulatory standards.

However, applicants and employees are prohibited from being impaired or under the influence of alcohol, illegal drugs, or other prohibited substances while working, operating Company vehicles or equipment, performing safety sensitive duties, conducting Company business, or while on Company property, consistent with applicable law.

**Role Summary**

Parklane is opening a brand-new manufacturing facility in Michigan, and we are looking for a Plant Manager to work with us to build it from the ground up. As the senior leader on site, you will have accountability for the plant: safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, and culture. You will lead a team of up to 150 employees and be supported by Parklane’s shared services groups, including Engineering, Supply Chain, Human Resources, and Finance, so you can focus on running a safe, high-performing operation and setting the standard for how Parklane operates in Michigan.

**Key Responsibilities**

Site Leadership & Start-Up

* Own the overall performance of the Michigan facility, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, and cost
* Lead the ramp-up of the new site, establishing operating rhythms, processes, and standards aligned with Parklane’s practices
* Develop and execute site plans and budgets in partnership with Finance and senior leadership
* Serve as the face of Parklane in the local community, with customers, vendors, and regulators

Operations & Production

* Direct day-to-day manufacturing, fabrication, assembly, and shipping activities to meet customer commitments
* Work with production scheduling and Supply Chain to balance capacity, labor, and material availability
* Drive continuous improvement and lean practices to improve throughput, reduce waste, and control cost
* Track and report on site KPIs, and act quickly on gaps to plan

Safety, Quality & Compliance

* Champion a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements
* Partner with QHSE to implement and sustain Parklane’s quality management system and drive corrective actions to closure
* Maintain a clean, organized, audit-ready facility and well-maintained equipment

People Leadership

* Recruit, develop, and lead plant leaders, supervisors, and front-line teams, building a strong bench for a growing site
* Partner with Human Resources on hiring, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and engagement
* Set clear expectations, coach for accountability, and recognize results in line with Parklane’s core values
* Build a positive, inclusive culture where employees feel safe, respected, and invested in the site’s success

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Engineering on product design, manufacturability, and technical issues
* Partner with Supply Chain on procurement, inventory, logistics, and supplier performance
* Collaborate with Finance on budgeting, cost control, and financial reporting
* Leverage shared services across the organization to support the site efficiently, and provide feedback to continuously improve that support

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 8+ years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including 3+ years in a plant management or senior site leadership role
* Proven experience leading a workforce of 100+ in a manufacturing or fabrication environment
* Experience launching, expanding, or transforming a facility is a strong asset
* Strong working knowledge of lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and quality systems (ISO 9001 exposure preferred)
* Solid understanding of OSHA and workplace safety, environmental, and employment regulations in the U.S.
* Financial acumen, including budgeting, P&L awareness, and cost management
* Experience with ERP systems and data-driven performance management (D365 an asset)
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills, with the ability to influence across a matrixed organization
* Hands-on, accountable, and comfortable building structure in a fast-paced, evolving environment
